integrity: Explicit algebraic transport-dual equality and exact Gaussian projection establish the claim; symbolic and rational computations are supplementary, not substitutes for the continuum proof.
limitations: Standard unit-interval Brownian motion; centered degree-one time weight; two exact exogenous observations with prescribed uniform marginal times in opposite halves; no claims for noisy observations or unrestricted site marginals. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Antithetic coupling uniquely minimizes two-stratum Brownian polynomial-moment quadrature risk
